loaded: Retained savanna brush/reed and alpine pigment code

rounds.hypothesis: Continuous community pigments and gentle terrain can establish prairie before fine vegetation.
rounds.observed: Mustard-colored bare-earth reading, low foreground variation and ring-edge streaks.

rounds.hypothesis: A shared nonuniform terrain grid fixes cracks; greener pigments separate communities.
rounds.observed: Continuous terrain and greener substrate improve the technical foundation; human-height view remains flat/lawn-like.
rounds.decision: retain technical fixes, not artistic approval

rounds.hypothesis: Meso-scale variation, slightly stronger long rolls, clearer texture detail and explicit sky ordering improve grounded grassland character.
rounds.observed: Large green/gold communities are visible from elevation, but human-height still compresses them into flat bands. Ground lacks convincing intermediate vegetation volume.
rounds.decision: retain isolated diagnostic prototype only; Gate A fails

highestPriorityDefects.defect: Human-height surface reads as a low-detail lawn/plane rather than an attractive flowing prairie.
Value shapes collapse into near-horizontal strips at the low viewpoint; elevated community pattern is not sufficient.
Existing sky is reusable, but the overall reference warmth/depth and natural foreground framing are absent at this stage.

nextHypothesis.description: A continuous low grass-mass surface with vegetation-scale relief and normals, colored from the same community fields, may supply the missing intermediate shapes before fine blades. Avoid separate strip patches, intersecting cards and arbitrary density increases.
